entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A sentient silver golem and planeswalker with near-complete mastery over artifacts, created by Urza.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The planeswalker who created Karn over 1200 years ago; Karn's father.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The source of the influence that twisted Karn's created world; Karn vows to destroy the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Karn, after finding friends, saving the Multiverse and becoming a planeswalker, sets off to create his own legacy.
events.quote: After finding true friends, saving the Multiverse, and becoming a Planeswalker, Karn set off to create his own legacy.

events.summary: Karn's created world is twisted by the influence of Phyrexia through his own accidental actions.
events.quote: that world became twisted by the influence of Phyrexia.

events.summary: Karn is determined to stop at nothing until the Phyrexians are destroyed.
events.quote: Karn will stop at nothing until they are destroyed.

relations.quote: Created over 1200 years ago by the Planeswalker Urza
Determined to prevent the Phyrexians from usurping his legacy
